reason: A persistent memory and context-management plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores scoped memories, supports selective injection and retrieval, and optionally uses external providers for semantic search or retrieval decisions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按对话、项目和全局范围管理持久记忆、选择性注入上下文及按需检索的功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with persistent conversation, project, and global memory, selective context injection, and on-demand retrieval.

capabilities: Stores and edits conversation, project, profile, and global memory on the local filesystem
Injects selected memory into agent context
Provides memory read, write, search, delete, import, and export tools
Performs local keyword or semantic memory retrieval
Can send messages and memory content to configured external embedding or language-model providers
